description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Idaho Statutes (Idaho Code) by citation. "18-4001" is murder; "32-717" lists child custody factors. Accepts natural forms: "18-4001", "Idaho Code 18-4001", "I.C. § 18-4001". Returns the current statutory text, the official catchline, chapter/title context, and the amendment HISTORY line Idaho prints on nearly every section (e.g. "[18-4001, added 1972, ch. 336, sec. 1, p. 928; am. 1977...]"). Idaho publishes the CURRENT text only — no per-year historical archive of statute text (only session-law PDF volumes organized by session chapter, not by Code citation); this tool says so rather than guessing. Keyless. Use for "what does Idaho Code 18-4001 say" or to check an Idaho statute a case or lease relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, title-number, e.g. "18-4001" (murder) or "55-307" (landlord access to leased premises). Some sections carry a letter suffix, e.g. "18-101A".
